files.docs/decisions.md:
# Decisions

## Frame sizes

Sellers give frame sizes as letters (M, L), inches or centimetres.
We store centimetres because most Subito and Blocket listings already use them,
and letter sizes map to a range so a 54 cm frame and an 'M' can still match.

events.title: M2 Normalized listings
events.what: Make listings comparable: one size unit, EUR prices and no duplicate bikes.

events.title: M3 Comparison and alerts
events.what: Show price comparisons per bike model and tell users when prices drop.
